get.description:
This endpoint returns all chat conversations that belong to the currently authenticated user.
A valid JWT token must be provided in the Authorization header. The user's ID is extracted from
the token claims and used to fetch associated chat data.

If the user's ID is missing or not a valid GUID, a 401 Unauthorized response is returned.
If a validation or internal error occurs, appropriate error responses are provided.

401.description: Unauthorized – missing or invalid JWT token.

get.description:
This endpoint returns a subset of messages from a given conversation, starting after the specified message ID.
It requires a valid JWT token provided in the Authorization header. The user's identity is inferred from the token,
and only messages from conversations that the user has access to will be returned.

If the conversation ID or message ID is invalid, or the user does not have access, appropriate error responses will be returned.

requestBody.description: DTO containing the conversation ID and the starting message ID for pagination.

200.description: Returns the paginated list of messages.

400.description: Invalid input or validation failure (e.g. malformed GUID).

401.description: Unauthorized – missing or invalid JWT token.

404.description: Conversation not found or user does not have access.

post.description:
This endpoint allows an authenticated user to send a friend invitation to another user
by providing sender and recipient GUIDs. The system returns an appropriate response based on
the outcome, including validation errors, conflicts, or if the recipient was not found.

requestBody.description: The invitation data including sender and recipient user GUIDs.

400.description: Invalid invitation data (e.g., malformed or missing GUIDs).

401.description: Unauthorized – valid JWT token is required.

404.description: The recipient user was not found.

409.description: A conflict occurred (e.g., invitation already exists).

get.description:
This endpoint allows an authenticated user to retrieve all friend invitations
addressed to the specified user by their GUID. If the user does not exist,
a 404 response is returned. In case of invalid input or other issues, an appropriate error is returned.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The GUID of the user whose invitations should be retrieved.

401.description: Unauthorized – valid JWT token is required.

404.description: The specified user was not found.

get.description:
This endpoint allows an authenticated user to search for other users to invite by providing a text query.
The search is performed server-side, excluding users that are already invited or already friends.
The user making the request must be authenticated via a valid JWT token containing a valid GUID identifier.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text to match usernames or display names against.

400.description: Invalid request (e.g., empty or malformed input).

401.description: Unauthorized – JWT token missing, invalid, or malformed GUID.

post.description:
This endpoint allows an authenticated user to decline a friend invitation from another user.
Both sender and recipient GUIDs must be provided in the request body. If the invitation does not exist
or has already been handled, a 404 or 400 response is returned accordingly.

requestBody.description: The invitation data containing sender and recipient user GUIDs.

400.description: Invalid data provided (e.g., malformed or missing GUIDs).

401.description: Unauthorized – valid JWT token is required.

404.description: Invitation not found or already declined.

post.description:
This endpoint allows an authenticated user to accept a friend invitation by providing the sender and recipient GUIDs.
On success, the users are added to each other's friend lists. If the invitation does not exist,
is invalid, or a conflict occurs (e.g., users are already friends), an appropriate error is returned.

requestBody.description: The invitation data containing sender and recipient user GUIDs.

200.description: Invitation accepted successfully; users are now friends.

400.description: Invalid data provided (e.g., malformed or missing GUIDs).

401.description: Unauthorized – valid JWT token is required.

409.description: Conflict – users are already friends or invitation was already accepted.

get.description:
This endpoint allows an authenticated user to fetch all users that are marked as friends
of the specified user identified by their GUID. If the input is invalid, or an unexpected error occurs,
the appropriate status code and message are returned.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The GUID of the user whose friends should be retrieved.

401.description: Unauthorized – valid JWT token is required.

post.description:
This endpoint creates a new user using a username and password. If the username already exists,
a conflict response is returned. On success, basic user data is returned.

requestBody.description: The registration data including username and password.

400.description: Invalid registration data (e.g., password policy not met).

post.description:
This endpoint validates the provided login credentials. If authentication is successful, it returns a JWT access token
and a refresh token for session management. If the user does not exist or the credentials are invalid, an appropriate error is returned.

requestBody.description: The login credentials, including username and password.

post.description:
This endpoint validates the provided refresh token and, if valid, issues a new access token.
It is typically used when the current access token has expired but the refresh token is still valid.

requestBody.description: The object containing the refresh token string.

400.description: The refresh token is invalid or malformed (e.g., structurally incorrect).

401.description: The refresh token is valid in format but unauthorized (e.g., expired, revoked, or forged).

patch.description:
This endpoint allows an authenticated user to update their username. It verifies whether the new username
is already taken and returns a conflict response if so. The user ID is extracted from the JWT token.

parameters.name: newUsername
parameters.description: The new username to assign to the current user.

200.description: Username successfully updated. Returns the new username.

400.description: The provided username is null, empty, or invalid.

401.description: The access token is missing, invalid, or refers to a non-existent user.

409.description: The desired username is already taken by another user.

500.description: An unexpected server error occurred while updating the username.

get.description:
This endpoint retrieves a user based on their unique GUID identifier.
The request requires authorization, and the user must exist in the system.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The GUID of the user to retrieve.

500.description: Unexpected server error occurred while retrieving the user.

get.description:
This endpoint returns a list of users whose usernames contain the provided text.
Optionally, the currently authenticated user can be excluded from the results.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text to search for within usernames.

parameters.name: excludeCurrentUser
parameters.description: Whether to exclude the currently authenticated user from the result.

400.description: The search text is empty or does not meet length constraints.

401.description: Access token is missing or user ID is invalid.

500.description: Unexpected server error occurred while retrieving users.
